verses.en: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
verses.pt: Disse Jesus a seus discípulos: É impossível que não venham tropeços, mas ai daquele por quem vierem!
verses.en_web: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his disciples, It is necessary for causes of trouble to come about, but unhappy is he by whom they come.

verses.en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
verses.pt: Melhor lhe fora que se lhe pendurasse ao pescoço uma pedra de moinho e fosse lançado ao mar, do que fazer tropeçar um destes pequeninos.
verses.en_web: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.
verses.en_bbe: It would be well for him if a great stone was put round his neck and he was dropped into the sea, before he made trouble for any of these little ones.

verses.en: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
verses.pt: Tende cuidado de vós mesmos; se teu irmão pecar, repreende-o; e se ele se arrepender, perdoa-lhe.
verses.en_web: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.
verses.en_bbe: Give attention to yourselves: if your brother does wrong, say a sharp word to him; and if he has sorrow for his sin, let him have forgiveness.

verses.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
verses.pt: Mesmo se pecar contra ti sete vezes no dia, e sete vezes vier ter contigo, dizendo: Arrependo-me; tu lhe perdoarás.
verses.en_web: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”
verses.en_bbe: And if he does you wrong seven times in a day, and seven times comes to you and says, I have regret for what I have done; let him have forgiveness.

verses.en: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
verses.pt: Disseram então os apóstolos ao Senhor: Aumenta-nos a fé.
verses.en_web: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
verses.en_bbe: And the twelve said to the Lord, Make our faith greater.

verses.en: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
verses.pt: Respondeu o Senhor: Se tivésseis fé como um grão de mostarda, diríeis a esta amoreira: Desarraiga-te, e planta-te no mar; e ela vos obedeceria.
verses.en_web: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, If your faith was only as great as a grain of mustard seed, you might say to this tree, Be rooted up and planted in the sea; and it would be done.

verses.en: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
verses.pt: Qual de vós, tendo um servo a lavrar ou a apascentar gado, lhe dirá, ao voltar ele do campo: chega-te já, e reclina-te à mesa?
verses.en_web: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table,’
verses.en_bbe: But which of you, having a servant who is ploughing or keeping sheep, will say to him, when he comes in from the field, Come now and be seated and have a meal,

verses.en: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
verses.pt: Não lhe dirá antes: Prepara-me a ceia, e cinge-te, e serve-me, até que eu tenha comido e bebido, e depois comerás tu e beberás?
verses.en_web: and will not rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me, while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?
verses.en_bbe: Will he not say, Get a meal for me, and make yourself ready and see to my needs till I have had my food and drink; and after that you may have yours?

verses.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
verses.pt: Porventura agradecerá ao servo, porque este fez o que lhe foi mandado?
verses.en_web: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.
verses.en_bbe: Does he give praise to the servant because he did what was ordered?

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
verses.pt: Assim também vós, quando fizerdes tudo o que vos for mandado, dizei: Somos servos inúteis; fizemos somente o que devíamos fazer.
verses.en_web: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, when you have done all the things which are given you to do, say, There is no profit in us, for we have only done what we were ordered to do.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, indo ele a Jerusalém, passava pela divisa entre a Samária e a Galiléia.
verses.en_web: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that when they were on the way to Jerusalem he went through Samaria and Galilee.

verses.en: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
verses.pt: Ao entrar em certa aldeia, saíram-lhe ao encontro dez leprosos, os quais pararam de longe,
verses.en_web: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.
verses.en_bbe: And when he went into a certain small town he came across ten men who were lepers, and they, keeping themselves at a distance,

verses.en: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
verses.pt: e levantaram a voz, dizendo: Jesus, Mestre, tem compaixão de nós!
verses.en_web: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
verses.en_bbe: Said, in loud voices, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

verses.en: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
verses.pt: Ele, logo que os viu, disse-lhes: Ide, e mostrai-vos aos sacerdotes. E aconteceu que, enquanto iam, ficaram limpos.
verses.en_web: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
verses.en_bbe: And when he saw them he said, Go, and let the priests see you. And, while they were going, they were made clean.

verses.en: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
verses.pt: Um deles, vendo que fora curado, voltou glorificando a Deus em alta voz;
verses.en_web: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.
verses.en_bbe: And one of them, when he saw that he was clean, turning back, gave praise to God in a loud voice;

verses.en: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
verses.pt: e prostrou-se com o rosto em terra aos pés de Jesus, dando-lhe graças; e este era samaritano.
verses.en_web: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
verses.en_bbe: And, falling down on his face at the feet of Jesus, he gave the credit to him; and he was a man of Samaria.

verses.en: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
verses.pt: Perguntou, pois, Jesus: Não foram limpos os dez? E os nove, onde estão?
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said, Were there not ten men who were made clean? where are the nine?

verses.en: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
verses.pt: Não se achou quem voltasse para dar glória a Deus, senão este estrangeiro?
verses.en_web: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this stranger?”
verses.en_bbe: Have not any of them come back to give glory to God, but only this one from a strange land?

verses.en: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe: Levanta-te, e vai; a tua fé te salvou.
verses.en_web: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Get up, and go on your way; your faith has made you well.

verses.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
verses.pt: Sendo Jesus interrogado pelos fariseus sobre quando viria o reino de Deus, respondeu-lhes: O reino de Deus não vem com aparência exterior;
verses.en_web: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;
verses.en_bbe: And when the Pharisees put questions to him about when the kingdom of God would come, he gave them an answer and said, The kingdom of God will not come through observation:

verses.en: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
verses.pt: nem dirão: Ei-lo aqui! ou: Eí-lo ali! pois o reino de Deus está dentro de vós.
verses.en_web: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
verses.en_bbe: And men will not say, See, it is here! or, There! for the kingdom of God is among you.

verses.en: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not seeit.
verses.pt: Então disse aos discípulos: Dias virão em que desejareis ver um dos dias do Filho do homem, e não o vereis.
verses.en_web: He said to the disciples, “The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his disciples, The time will come when you will have a great desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, but you will not see it.

verses.en: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
verses.pt: Dir-vos-ão: Ei-lo ali! ou: Ei-lo aqui! não vades, nem os sigais;
verses.en_web: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away, nor follow after them,
verses.en_bbe: And if they say to you, See, it is there! or, It is here! do not go away, or go after them.

verses.en: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
verses.pt: pois, assim como o relâmpago, fuzilando em uma extremidade do céu, ilumina até a outra extremidade, assim será também o Filho do homem no seu dia.
verses.en_web: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.
verses.en_bbe: For as in a thunderstorm the bright light is seen from one end of the sky to the other, so will the Son of man be when his time comes.

verses.en: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
verses.pt: Mas primeiro é necessário que ele padeça muitas coisas, e que seja rejeitado por esta geração.
verses.en_web: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
verses.en_bbe: But first, he will have to undergo much and be put on one side by this generation.

verses.en: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
verses.pt: Como aconteceu nos dias de Noé, assim também será nos dias do Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: As it was in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.
verses.en_bbe: And as it was in the days of Noah, so will it be in the day of the Son of man.

verses.en: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.pt: Comiam, bebiam, casavam e davam-se em casamento, até o dia em que Noé entrou na arca, e veio o dilúvio e os destruiu a todos.
verses.en_web: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
verses.en_bbe: They were feasting and taking wives and getting married, till the day of the overflowing of the waters, when Noah went into the ark, and they all came to destruction.

verses.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
verses.pt: Como também da mesma forma aconteceu nos dias de Ló: comiam, bebiam, compravam, vendiam, plantavam e edificavam;
verses.en_web: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, in the days of Lot; they were feasting and trading, they were planting and building;

verses.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
verses.pt: mas no dia em que Ló saiu de Sodoma choveu do céu fogo e enxofre, e os destruiu a todos;
verses.en_web: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky, and destroyed them all.
verses.en_bbe: But on the day when Lot went out of Sodom, fire came down from heaven and destruction came on them all.

verses.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
verses.pt: assim será no dia em que o Filho do homem se há de manifestar.
verses.en_web: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.
verses.en_bbe: So will it be in the day of the revelation of the Son of man.

verses.en: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
verses.pt: Naquele dia, quem estiver no eirado, tendo os seus bens em casa, não desça para tirá-los; e, da mesma sorte, o que estiver no campo, não volte para trás.
verses.en_web: In that day, he who will be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.
verses.en_bbe: On that day, if anyone is on the roof of the house, and his goods are in the house, let him not go down to take them away; and let him who is in the field not go back to his house.

verses.en: Remember Lot’s wife.
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos da mulher de Ló.
verses.en_web: Remember Lot’s wife!
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind Lot's wife.

verses.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
verses.pt: Qualquer que procurar preservar a sua vida, perdê-la-á, e qualquer que a perder, conservá-la-á.
verses.en_web: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.
verses.en_bbe: If anyone makes an attempt to keep his life, it will be taken from him, but if anyone gives up his life, he will keep it.

verses.en: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
verses.pt: Digo-vos: Naquela noite estarão dois numa cama; um será tomado, e o outro será deixado.
verses.en_web: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, In that night there will be two men sleeping in one bed, and one will be taken away and the other let go.

verses.en: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.pt: Duas mulheres estarão juntas moendo; uma será tomada, e a outra será deixada.
verses.en_web: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left.”
verses.en_bbe: Two women will be crushing grain together; one will be taken away and the other let go.

verses.en: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.pt: [Dois homens estarão no campo; um será tomado, e o outro será deixado.]
verses.en_web: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.en: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.pt: Perguntaram-lhe: Onde, Senhor? E respondeu-lhes: Onde estiver o corpo, aí se ajuntarão também os abutres.
verses.en_web: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together.”
verses.en_bbe: And they, answering him, said, Where, Lord? And he said to them, Where the body is, there will the eagles come together.
